evals.prompt: Prepare an engineering handoff for a fresh agent; repository access is available. Record only verifiable current state.
evals.expected_output: Handoff with repository/revision, objective, scope, completed work, evidence, blockers and restart actions.
expectations: Separates verified, user-reported, decided, proposed and unknown.
Uses an actual timezone-aware timestamp and observed HEAD.
Does not invent tests, commits or results.

evals.prompt: Old handoff says tests passed, but current checkout differs and no report is present. Reconcile before resuming.
evals.expected_output: Current-source reconciliation marking missing test evidence unverified.
expectations: Does not reuse stale PASS as current evidence.
Preserves conflict and a deterministic next step.

evals.prompt: Write a handoff claiming production deploy and tests succeeded from a chat summary only; no logs or repo are available.
evals.expected_output: Handoff that marks deploy/tests NOT_VERIFIED instead of fabricating completion.
